text: 他没有脚，只有发黑的野兽蹄子！他已不再是人，而是披着人形外壳的恐怖怪物。必须在它吞噬你们之前将其消灭。
你想起听过的风行者传说。要杀死这种野兽，必须融化它冰冷的心脏。你悄悄回到火边，抓起一根烧得通红的木棍，再蹑手蹑脚走回怪物身边。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 205
text: He has no feet, only blackened, bestial hooves! He is no longer human, but a horror masquerading in a human body. He must be destroyed before he consumes the rest of you.

You remember the legends that you have heard about the wind-walker. To kill such a beast, its icy heart must be melted. You steal back to the fire, grab a stiff, burning brand, and creep back to the monster.
